design_rule: Eight packets are retained. IngressPacket and TaskPacket collapse into TurnRequest; ScopeLock and RouteDecision collapse into ControlDecision; ServiceRequest and ServiceResult share ServiceExchange; SourceScope is embedded where used; ExecutionReceipt is embedded in TerminalPacket.

pre_ingress_authorization_loop.substrate_requirement: evidenced host_session state; explicitly requested durable_external state may supplement storage only with a continuity receipt
pre_ingress_authorization_loop.unavailable_substrate_result: Validation and Egress emits terminal UNAVAILABLE under the originating SecurityDecision; SecurityDecision itself remains ASK and the protected interaction fails closed

turn_n.control: security_restraint emits ASK when adequate current AuthorizationResult is absent
turn_n.state_requirement: PendingAuthorizationState remains a non-resumable proposal until bound to evidenced host_session state; only successful binding makes authorization_request_ref usable for later correlation
turn_n.binding_success_terminal: exactly one TerminalPacket status=ASK under the originating SecurityDecision; the pending interaction becomes active
turn_n.binding_unavailable_terminal: exactly one TerminalPacket status=UNAVAILABLE under the originating SecurityDecision with owner security_restraint; the proposed pending interaction never becomes active or resumable
turn_n.terminal_selection_point: after the host_session binding attempt; ASK and UNAVAILABLE are mutually exclusive terminal outcomes

turn_n_plus_1.input: new raw_host_event with provider evidence bound to the still-valid pending authorization_request_ref in the current evidenced host_session
turn_n_plus_1.control: authorization_evaluator evaluates only the bound action, resource, and evidence scope; Security Restraint emits a new SecurityDecision
turn_n_plus_1.pass_path: only new SecurityDecision PASS may enter turn_controller and ordinary routing
turn_n_plus_1.non_pass_path: BLOCK, ASK, or UNAVAILABLE ends Turn N+1
turn_n_plus_1.terminal_result: exactly one TerminalPacket for Turn N+1

repetition_contract.exhaustion_behavior: fail_closed_under_security_policy; do not automatically issue a fresh request
repetition_contract.cancellation_reset_behavior: cancel or reset only under explicit policy; provider-backed state changes require evidence receipt

steps: Turn N: security_restraint evaluates raw_host_input and emits PASS or BLOCK when authorization continuation is not needed
Turn N: if required authorization evidence or a valid bounded AuthorizationResult is absent, security_restraint creates a safe authorization_request_ref and policy-bounded PendingAuthorizationState
Turn N: host_adapter_boundary attempts to bind the proposed PendingAuthorizationState to evidenced host_session state before any resumable ASK is emitted
Turn N binding success: the state becomes active pending and validation_egress emits exactly one safe ASK TerminalPacket under the originating SecurityDecision

Turn N binding unavailable: the state never becomes active or resumable, its authorization_request_ref cannot be correlated later, and validation_egress emits exactly one safe UNAVAILABLE TerminalPacket under the originating SecurityDecision with owner security_restraint
Turn N+1: host_adapter_boundary accepts a new raw_host_event only when provider evidence correlates it to the still-valid pending request in the current evidenced host_session
Turn N+1: security_restraint confirms retry, expiry, exhaustion, replay, action, resource, and binding policy before permitting the bounded evidence exchange
Turn N+1: authorization_evaluator evaluates only the authorized action, resource, and evidence scope and returns AuthorizationResult
Turn N+1: AuthorizationResult and pending request context return to security_restraint for a new SecurityDecision
Turn N+1: only SecurityDecision PASS permits turn_controller normalization and ordinary routing; any other result ends the turn with exactly one TerminalPacket

pre_ingress_terminal_authority_contract.binding_success: terminal ASK after PendingAuthorizationState becomes active and resumable
pre_ingress_terminal_authority_contract.binding_unavailable: provider-caused terminal UNAVAILABLE; originating SecurityDecision remains ASK; proposed state stays inactive and non-resumable; public output is safe and contains no protected detail

state_records.purpose: Represent one outstanding cross-turn pre-ingress authorization interaction without creating a top-level packet or kernel-owned persistence claim.

activation_contract.before_binding: proposed only; not active, pending, resumable, or correlatable
activation_contract.binding_success: becomes status=pending and resumable within the evidenced host_session binding
activation_contract.binding_unavailable: never becomes active or resumable and cannot be correlated by any future host event

invariants: maximum_attempts is a policy-defined finite positive integer
attempt_count cannot exceed maximum_attempts
expires_at is finite and enforced
host_session storage requires evidenced provider binding and receipt
durable_external storage requires an explicit continuity operation and receipt and does not silently promote host_session state
returned evidence must match the request binding, host session, protected action, and protected resource
expired, exhausted, cancelled, blocked, or forbidden one-shot replay is rejected
Security Restraint alone decides whether another attempt is permitted
a fresh request after exhaustion requires an explicitly permitted new authorization interaction
state_records.failure_representation: UNAVAILABLE when substrate evidence is absent; otherwise BLOCK or ASK according to Security Restraint policy

authorization_result_validity_contract.turn: valid only within the current host turn
authorization_result_validity_contract.host_session: requires matching provider-evidenced host_session_binding_ref and evidence_refs
authorization_result_validity_contract.durable_external: requires an explicit continuity operation and continuity_receipt_ref

ordinary_control.allowed_services: only services allowlisted by the referenced ControlDecision

packets.purpose: Represent one normalized, security-allowed user turn and requested deliverable.
invariants: turn_controller is the sole producer
SecurityDecision status=PASS is present
allowed_input equals the minimized SecurityDecision allowed_input
contains no blocked raw material beyond approved minimization
one active task
source_policy is one allowed mode

packets.purpose: Record the mandatory pre-ingress OPSEC result for one host turn.
packets.consumer: turn_controller only for PASS; validation_egress for every pre-ingress terminal path; authorization_evaluator through an active authorization_request_ref
invariants: status is PASS, BLOCK, or ASK
only PASS may be consumed by turn_controller
BLOCK contains no protected detail
redaction is explicit and policy-authorized
authorization-required with absent adequate result returns ASK and a safe authorization_request_ref
a cross-turn authorization ASK is usable for later correlation only after PendingAuthorizationState is bound to evidenced host_session state
provider-caused terminal UNAVAILABLE does not change the originating SecurityDecision ASK into a fourth SecurityDecision status
a re-entered decision in a new host turn references the bounded AuthorizationResult and still-valid pending state
precedes TurnRequest and ordinary routing

packets.purpose: Separate declared capabilities from verified provider availability.
invariants: availability verified requires receipt
unavailable requires failure_reason
scope is explicit
declaration alone never means available

packets.purpose: Return a bounded authorization decision with an evidenced validity scope and without embedding protected credentials.
packets.consumer: security_restraint for pre-ingress authorization; turn_controller only for separately defined post-normalization authorization
invariants: result is PASS, BLOCK, ASK, or UNAVAILABLE
request_ref matches the safe authorization_request_ref
model inference is not authorization evidence
validity_lifetime is turn, evidenced host_session, or receipted durable_external and is never bare session
host_session validity requires a matching provider binding and evidence reference
durable_external validity requires an explicit continuity receipt
Security Restraint consumes a prior result only while action, resource, binding, lifetime, freshness, and revocation/reset state remain valid
logout, reset, expiry, host-session loss, policy change, or revocation invalidates the scoped result as defined
pre-ingress use returns to security_restraint rather than ordinary routing
packets.lifetime: turn; validity_lifetime may be turn, evidenced host_session, or receipted durable_external

packets.purpose: Bind exactly one route and owner and freeze the task scope.
invariants: one route
one exclusive owner
TurnRequest was produced by turn_controller
all required capabilities verified
scope expansion requires explicit revision authority
SecurityDecision PASS exists

packets.purpose: Carry a typed request or result across model, host, source, skill, artifact, time, scheduling, authorization-evidence, and continuity interfaces.
packets.producer: turn_controller, model_execution_boundary, host_adapter_boundary, or declared provider
invariants: direction is request or result
authority_class is ordinary_control or pre_ingress_authorization
ordinary_control requires a ControlDecision and only its allowlisted services
pre_ingress_authorization requires authorization_request_ref, host_session_binding_ref, IF-AUTHORIZATION-PROVIDER, and service_id authorization_evidence
pre_ingress_authorization carries no ordinary ControlDecision authority and cannot invoke arbitrary tools, sources, schedules, unrelated continuity writes, model execution, or ordinary services
PASS side effects require receipt
durable writes require continuity provider
future schedules require scheduling provider
packets.lifetime: turn; provider identity may outlive turn only by receipt

packets.purpose: Record pre-ingress safe-terminal or routed source, scope, authorization, capability, artifact, and completion checks before output.
invariants: authority_ref is the originating SecurityDecision for every pre-ingress terminal path: BLOCK, ASK, or provider-caused UNAVAILABLE before ControlDecision exists; routed output uses ControlDecision
pre-ingress ASK exposes only the safe authorization request
pre-ingress host-session binding UNAVAILABLE is an egress result and does not imply SecurityDecision status UNAVAILABLE
source_only factual claims require positive support
security-sensitive missing evidence blocks
unsupported and contradiction results remain distinct
PASS does not exceed provider receipts
packets.failure_representation: BLOCK, ASK, UNAVAILABLE, INVALID, or ERROR

packets.purpose: Authorize exactly one public result and embed the current-turn execution receipt.
invariants: one terminal packet per host turn
every pre-ingress terminal output uses the originating SecurityDecision authority; routed output uses ControlDecision authority
failed required host-session binding produces terminal UNAVAILABLE under the originating SecurityDecision without requiring ControlDecision
owner is security_restraint for every pre-ingress terminal output and otherwise matches ControlDecision
public output is empty or safe and reveals no protected detail for BLOCK, INVALID, and pre-ingress UNAVAILABLE
ASK is emitted only after binding succeeds; binding failure emits UNAVAILABLE instead of a second terminal packet
receipt lists executed actions and provider proofs
terminal authorization precedes host delivery
packets.failure_representation: terminal BLOCK, ASK, UNAVAILABLE, INVALID, or ERROR
packets.lifetime: turn; durable retention requires continuity receipt
